prompt.task: Complete the entire login for Slack app in one continuous flow. First open Slack app. If it opens to an authenticated account or dashboard, sign out first and continue to the fresh sign-in flow; never treat an existing session as completion. Enter {user} in the email or username field. Enter No need only if a password is required and it is not marked as unnecessary. Choose the control that explicitly sends, requests, emails, or continues to a magic link. Once a new magic link has been requested or sent, leave Slack app and open the Gmail app. Navigate to the main inbox of Gmail. If a message detail page is open, go back to the main inbox. Refresh the inbox (swipe down from the top) and wait 3 seconds for it to load. Open the newest email matched to Slack app at the top of the list. Find the magic link or login button inside the email and click it directly. Wait 2 seconds and confirm that login succeeded or the main page is visible. Do not report success unless the screen explicitly confirms a successful login or you can see the main page.

auto_verifier.reason: Start evidence shows only the launcher; the log then clears Slack's stale session, performs a fresh magic-link flow for {user}, and the final controller evidence shows com.Slack's authenticated post-login notification onboarding.
